scope: Only two concrete floor atlas rectangles. Preserve all other pixels exactly.
source: rooftop-weathering-02/terrace-book.pxo, final revised brick-red roofs and erased shop signs
sourcePhotoFeatures: Photo 1: irregular connected repairs and branching fissures; washed grey concrete with faint old joints and very local chalk traces.
Photo 2: bounded warm exposed repair next to an edge; clusters of rubbed wear and uneven patches; little uniform per-slab texture.
Photo 3: outdoor roof exposure and material ageing context; no geometry changed from this photograph.
paintDecisions: Retain a light quiet neutral-grey floor; base #989d97 differs from the previous #989c97 by only one green channel step.
Remove the old dense regular seam lattice and long aligned brush strips.
Place different connected fissure networks on north and south; local filled mortar varies in width on the one-pixel source grid.
Use unique bounded eroded repair and wash silhouettes; pooling stains keep only short interrupted tide arcs.
Concentrate aggregate and abrasion in sparse wear sites, with broad clean areas between them.
Native Pencil brush is always 1 px at the existing 16 texels/metre. All coloured masses are composed from that same source pixel unit.

references.title: Makkon Textures Concrete

references.learned: Diffuse-only retro concrete material hierarchy, larger coherent weathering fields and localised erosion; kept our own existing 16 px/m instead of copying its 32 px/m convention.
